entries.1d70ec399690c41e: Small and medium-sized enterprises and sole proprietors
entries.36fd294a236e388b: This business consists of Legal Media, which operates field-specialized legal media mainly serving lawyers, and Derivative Media, which serves advertisers other than lawyers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥6,242 million. The company had 127 consolidated employees as of October 31, 2025, and 1 consolidated subsidiary.
entries.390b7880c86d45fa: This business operates separate “Bennabi” sites for each of 8 case fields (divorce, traffic accidents, inheritance, labor issues, criminal cases, debt collection, debt consolidation and IT) and publishes advertisements for individual lawyers or law corporations. Under a stock-type revenue model that earns advertising income by multiplying the number of listing slots by the monthly flat-rate unit price per slot, revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥3,784 million.
entries.5798e0526ca85635: A company that operates, centered on the legal media for lawyers "Benavi", spin-off media, recruitment placement services and small-amount short-term insurance.
entries.59bc1aff8e624f11: This business provides placement services for personnel such as licensed lawyers, certified public accountants, tax accountants and corporate administration staff, and operates job sites such as “NO-LIMIT,” which specializes in lawyers, “Hi-Standard,” which specializes in certified public accountants and tax accountants, and “BEET AGENT,” which specializes in corporate administration staff, among others. Under a performance-based model that earns placement fees from hiring companies when a candidate is hired and joins the company, revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥335 million.
entries.7ab346434f940c25: This business is conducted by consolidated subsidiary ASIRO Small-Amount Short-Term Insurance Inc. (ownership of voting rights 78.87%), which operates a small-amount short-term insurance business. It sells attorney fee insurance, which pays part of the costs incurred when a lawyer is engaged to resolve everyday-life troubles, and has stopped new sales promotion for individual products; it is concentrating its management resources on the attorney fee insurance “bonobo” for corporations and sole proprietors, which began sales in July 2025. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥69 million.
entries.8cfa9263b1c8762c: Advertiser companies such as job placement agencies
entries.d388fbcec52b40cd: This business operates media sites such as “Kyarizumu,” which serves job placement agencies, and “Uwaki Chōsa Navi” and “Hitosagashi no Madoguchi,” which serve detective agencies, among others. Users use the sites free of charge, and the business earns performance-based fees from advertising clients according to the number of inquiries from users, under a flow-type revenue model; revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥2,458 million.
